# Unified Movie Mission

The Awtsmoos renews each frame and scene; distinct vessels may shine without becoming the same machine.
Animator directs worlds and people, Captions moves text and graphic light, Nesher edits time and export right.

## Mission
Unify Geelooy's true movie-authoring apps behind one deterministic AI-writable movie document while preserving each app's specialty, then prove the protocol with an exact 180-second mixed 2D/3D showcase and runtime evidence.

## Observed Authoring Centers
- `apps/animator`: cinematic authoring, characters, camera, AI facade, film/export, procedural scene systems.
- `apps/captions/video`: Canvas-based 2D captions, backgrounds, particles, effects, text composition.
- `apps/nesher-studio`: NLE timeline/editor/export/WebCodecs surface.
- Other recording-capable apps are consumers unless their code proves general authoring responsibility.

## Non-negotiable Boundaries
- Do not overwrite concurrent Animator work.
- New shared modules first; adapter files second; only fresh-read integration points may be rewritten.
- Full-file writes only.
- Source modules stay small, readable, tab-indented, documented, and non-minified.
- AI input is declarative data with validation and capability discovery, not private DOM mutation.
- Mobile-first interaction and reduced-motion/accessibility behavior are part of completion.

## REMAINING_WORK
1. Inspect shared/movie signals and clean integration points in Captions and Nesher.
2. Freeze canonical movie document, scene, layer, camera, animation, chart, particle, character contracts.
3. Build validator/normalizer/capability manifest/time sampler.
4. Build app adapters without flattening app identities.
5. Build mobile AI movie dock only where conflict-free.
6. Create exact 180-second showcase with many scenes, angles, shapes, charts, text, particles, characters, 2D and 3D declarations.
7. Add protocol/adapter/showcase tests.
8. Integrate with current Animator API through conflict-free extension or standalone adapter.
9. Run syntax/unit/integration/app regression tests.
10. Render/export real 180-second artifact through the strongest existing render path available.
11. Verify duration/codec/size with ffprobe and inspect representative frames/runtime console.
12. Re-read every touched file, compare planned vs actual, resolve delta, and record final evidence.

## NEXT_ACTION
Inspect current shared modules and app integration seams, then execute Phase One through Phase Three before source writes.
